item.title: UAE reports drone and missile attack as Iran war ceasefire is challenged
item.description: The Iran war's shaky ceasefire was further strained on Friday as the United Arab Emirates responded to a missile and drone strikes.

item.title: Morning news brief
item.description: U.S. and Iran trade fire amid month-old ceasefire, Tennessee becomes first state to draw new U.S. House map after SCOTUS decision, U.S.'s continued strikes on alleged drug boats raise questions.

item.title: Military drills on the edge: U.S. and allies test capabilities near Asia's flash points
item.description: From drone boats to long-range missiles, the U.S. and its allies tested new military tactics in the Philippines, sharpening deterrence as tensions with China intensify.
